fact: A FAREI research scientist reports that Mauritius joined CropWatch-ICP in March 2021, prepared country crop bulletins in May 2021, did field monitoring of potato, pineapple, onion and tomato plantations with the GVG app in October-November 2022, and hosted a regional satellite crop monitoring workshop on 7-10 August 2023.
title: Mauritian Experience Crop Watch ICP: Application of Satellite Technology and remote sensing for Crop Monitoring
publisher: FAREI research scientist, for UNCTAD CropWatch-ICP
